products.name: Wall Coat
products.tagline: Durable acrylic/PVA coating for interior & exterior masonry.
products.description: Acrylic/PVA wall coating designed for durable decorative protection of interior and exterior masonry surfaces. Suitable for properly prepared surfaces, with good adhesion and coverage.
features: Suitable for properly prepared masonry surfaces
Recommended: 2 coats for a uniform finish

products.name: Wall Primer
products.alias: also on packaging as Gorilla Primer
products.tagline: Penetrating primer that prepares porous walls before finishing.
products.description: Penetrating/sealing primer that prepares porous surfaces and improves the adhesion and uniformity of the finishing coat.

products.name: Roof & Stoep
products.alias: also on packaging as Giraffe Roof & Stoep
products.tagline: Protective coating for roofs, floors, concrete and stoeps.
products.description: Durable coating for concrete, masonry and suitable roof/floor surfaces, providing colour and protective coverage.

products.name: Elegant Silk Interior
products.alias: also on packaging as Lion Silk Washable / Elegant Silk
products.tagline: Premium washable interior finish with a smooth silk sheen.
products.description: Premium washable interior coating with a smooth silk appearance, designed for areas requiring an attractive and cleanable finish.

products.name: Weather Coat Exterior
products.alias: also on packaging as Elephant Exterior
products.tagline: Exterior-grade colour and protection against outdoor weathering.
products.description: Exterior-grade coating formulated to provide decorative colour and protection against normal outdoor weathering.

products.name: Universal Undercoat
products.tagline: High-build preparatory coat for wood and metal.
products.description: High-build preparatory coating designed to improve adhesion, coverage and finish consistency before the final coat.

products.name: Pinkwood Primer
products.alias: also on packaging as Pink Wood Primer
products.tagline: Wood primer that seals and prepares timber for finishing.
products.description: Wood primer designed to seal and prepare timber before application of the finishing coat.

products.name: Red Oxide
products.description: Anti-corrosive primer for ferrous metal surfaces before application of a suitable finishing coat.

products.name: Gloss Enamel
products.tagline: High-gloss finish for properly prepared wood and metal.
products.description: High-gloss decorative finish for properly prepared wood and metal surfaces.

products.name: Brick Dressing
products.tagline: Protective, decorative coating for brick and masonry.
products.description: Protective decorative coating for brick and masonry, enhancing appearance while helping protect the substrate.

products.name: Vanish
products.tagline: Protective finishing and sealing for prepared surfaces.
products.description: Protective finishing/sealing product for suitable prepared surfaces.

products.name: Liquid Rubber Paint
products.description: Flexible waterproofing coating designed to form a protective membrane over suitable surfaces.
